description: In a locally finite preorder, in particular a finite poset, a < b exactly when a nonempty finite path of cover steps leads from a to b.
signature:
lt_iff_transGen_covBy.{u_2} {α : Type u_2} [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] {x y : α} :
  x < y ↔ Relation.TransGen (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⋖ x2) x y
